title: Framer/Motion Design
content: Apply Framer aesthetic with motion-focused design. Spring-based animations everywhere. Gesture interactions (drag, swipe). Parallax and scroll effects. Interactive prototypes. Component variants. Hover and tap animations. Shared element transitions. Physics-based bouncing. Keyframe sequences. Animation timelines.

variants.simple: Create animation-rich interface with spring physics, gestures, and micro-interactions.
variants.detailed: Apply Framer aesthetic with motion-focused design. Spring-based animations everywhere. Gesture interactions (drag, swipe). Parallax and scroll effects. Interactive prototypes. Component variants. Hover and tap animations. Shared element transitions. Physics-based bouncing. Keyframe sequences. Animation timelines.
variants.advanced: Apply Framer aesthetic with motion design patterns. Spring animations: all transitions use spring physics (stiffness, damping, mass), bouncy but controlled. Gestures: draggable elements with constraints, pan gestures, pinch-zoom where appropriate. Hover states: scale(1.02-1.05), subtle shadow increase, color transitions. Tap: scale(0.98) on press, immediate feedback. Page transitions: shared element animations between routes, crossfade backgrounds. Scroll: parallax layers at different speeds, reveal animations on enter viewport. Stagger: list items animate in sequence with delay, wave effects. Layout animations: animate between different layouts (grid to list), morph shapes. Interactive: cursor effects (magnetic buttons, custom cursor), canvas interactions. Micro-interactions: button loading states, success animations, toggle switches. Physics: momentum scrolling, throw with velocity, rubber-band limits. Keyframes: complex multi-step animations, orchestrated sequences. Reduced motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion, provide static alternatives. Performance: use transform and opacity, GPU-accelerated. Easing: custom bezier curves for character, spring for bounce. Variants: define animation variants, switch based on state. Exit animations: elements animate out before removal. Debug: animation inspector, slow motion toggle.
